notes: The two ONNX graphs are the trained networks with spectral normalisation left in the graph, so the exported weights are the weights the experiment trained.
Everything after the backbone is recomputed in JavaScript from this file, with the same formulas src/fd_distribution.py, src/calibrate.py and src/laplace_icla.py use.
The abstain thresholds are read off the test risk-coverage curve at 5 % risk; they are reported values, not tuning parameters.
